title: Education Cloud Consultant
text:
Merrowfield Partners is a Salesforce consulting partner that works with colleges and universities. We are looking for an Education Cloud Consultant to lead client work across the student lifecycle.

In this role you will
- Run discovery workshops with admissions, advising and student services teams, and turn what you hear into a solution design.
- Configure Education Cloud for the higher-ed student lifecycle: recruitment, admissions, enrollment, advising and alumni.
- Build OmniStudio flows for applications and student requests.
- Design and configure Experience Cloud portals for applicants and students.
- Work with the delivery team on integrations to the student information system.

You have
- Three or more years of Salesforce consulting, ideally in higher education.
- Education Cloud experience, with the Education Cloud Consultant certification or the plan to earn it.
- Hands-on OmniStudio and Experience Cloud work.
- Strong discovery and client facing skills.

notes: The selection changes from posting 1 to fit a higher-ed consultant role
